To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the information-driven synthesis approach is the best approach for sequential logic synthesis.
the new information-driven sequential logic synthesis tools are much better than the traditional tools and that the new uniform and consistent flow is the best way to use them.

1) The quality of the new logic synthesis flow and its harmony is very high, 2) the new flow produced circuits that were 25% smaller than circuits from traditional flow, 3) the new flow is very fast and efficient, 4) the new flow can produce circuits that are 30% faster and 25% smaller in comparison to the traditional flow.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of new ECA tools for sequential logic design.
the problem of the quality of the EDA tools, the problem that is not addressed in the EDA community, and the problem that is very important for the quality of modern VLSI systems.
the quality of the EDA tool chain, which is an important problem for the entire EDA community.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the new uniform and consistent approach to logic synthesis results in much better quality circuits than the traditional approach.
the new uniform information-driven logic synthesis flow is much better than the traditional flows.
the information-based logic synthesis tools are much better and much more consistent than all other tools in the market.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the information-based synthesis flow produces circuits with the best quality, the most consistent results, and the shortest design time.
the information-based logic synthesis approach is the most promising approach for the future EDA tools.
information-driven logic synthesis is a promising approach that should be further explored.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the new uniform approach is a promising direction in logic synthesis, which should be further investigated.
the new information-driven approach to sequential logic synthesis can be used to achieve much better quality results in the design of modem microprocessors and microcontrollers.
the new information-driven approach can be successfully applied to other EDA tools and flows.
